headline: John Kuttukaran Paul resigns from director posts in five PVSL subsidiaries
hook: Leadership changes at multiple subsidiary units
summary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited announced that Mr. John Kuttukaran Paul has resigned as a non-executive director across five of its subsidiary companies, including material subsidiary Prabal Motors Private Limited. The resignations took effect immediately from October 8, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing regarding board composition changes within the group subsidiaries. For an Indian retail investor holding PVSL shares, board shuffles at the subsidiary level carry minimal direct financial impact.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary board changes have no immediate bearing on stock value.
